extZaloOa.connect.failed: The account was not connected, and the reason was not one this screen can put into words. Check the state above before trying again.
extZaloOa.connect.sub: The App ID and App Secret come from developers.zalo.me. The token pair comes from running the Zalo authorization once — an OA administrator approves it in a browser and the tool prints the pair. Connecting spends the refresh token immediately and stores what replaces it, so paste a pair nothing else is still using.
extZaloOa.connect.title: Connect an Official Account
extZaloOa.connection.disconnectFailed: The account may still be connected. Check the state above before trying again.
extZaloOa.connection.sub: One Official Account serves the whole workspace. Nothing here shows a credential: the App Secret and both tokens are held by the installation's custodian and are never displayed.
extZaloOa.connection.title: This installation's Zalo Official Account
extZaloOa.error.account_changed: The stored credential now answers for a different Official Account than this connection was made for. Nothing was captured. Connect again with a pair for the account you mean to use.
extZaloOa.error.api_not_registered: The Zalo app has not enabled the permission group this needs. That is a free setting: open developers.zalo.me, and under Sản phẩm → Official Account enable the OA information, user message, send message and user management groups.
extZaloOa.error.connection_unusable: The connection could not be used. Connect again with a fresh token pair.
extZaloOa.error.credential_missing: No credential is on deposit for the administrator who connected this account. Connect again.
extZaloOa.error.member_not_permitted: The connecting administrator's access has changed, so nothing was captured. Review what they may see, or connect again as somebody else.
extZaloOa.error.package_too_low: This Official Account's package no longer includes the conversation API. Renew or upgrade it at oa.zalo.me — the package and its expiry are shown above.
extZaloOa.error.poll_failed: The last check did not finish. It will be tried again.
extZaloOa.error.provider_answer_unusable: Zalo answered something this connector could not read.
extZaloOa.error.provider_unavailable: Zalo could not be reached. The next check will try again.
extZaloOa.error.refresh_outcome_unknown: Zalo never reported whether the credential was renewed, and a Zalo refresh token can only be used once — so nobody can tell whether it still works. Connect again with a fresh pair.
extZaloOa.error.refresh_rotation_lost: Zalo renewed the credential and the replacement could not be stored. A Zalo refresh token is single-use, so the old one is gone: connect again with a fresh pair.
extZaloOa.error.refresh_token_rejected: Zalo refused to renew the credential. Connect again with a fresh pair.
extZaloOa.error.token_rejected: Zalo rejected the credential. Connect again with a fresh pair.
extZaloOa.noGrant: You have not been granted access to this connector.
extZaloOa.sub: Conversations with this Official Account land on the CRM timeline, and replies go back out as the Official Account.
extZaloOa.title: Zalo Official Account
